claim: A sliding or turning mechanism blocks the way in its rest state.
evidence: Assuming it cut E1M2 from 226 reachable sectors to 26.
A door's two portals are adjacent as often as opposite (E1M1 s63's are 512 apart on the same side); which state blocks is answered for only 5 of 628 swept mechanisms.
use: Decide which state blocks from the swept polygon, per mechanism.
instead: Either state of a swept mechanism may be the shut one; it cannot be read from the rest state or from the line between portal midpoints.
